summary: Nomura Holdings filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on September 17, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing that it will report second quarter fiscal 2027 operating results on October 28, 2026 at 15:30 Tokyo time. The notice is a routine scheduling announcement; financial statements and presentation materials will be posted to nomura.com, and a live audio webcast of the conference call will be delivered at 18:30 JST (09:30 GMT / 05:30 EDT). No terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; this is not a special situation.
